expected_level_description: You can: - build and test simple interfaces between systems - work on more complex integration as part of a wider team
You can: - design, code, test, correct and document simple programs or scripts under the direction of others
You can: - review requirements and specifications, and define test conditions - identify issues and risks associated with work - analyse and report test activities and results
You can: - help fix service faults following agreed procedures - carry out maintenance tasks on service support infrastructure
You can: - explain information security and the security controls available to protect solutions and services
You can: - read and use FHIR resources, profiles, and APIs - build or test simple integrations under guidance - check messages against a specification
You can: - explain the difference between a clinical terminology and a classification - recognise common terminologies such as SNOMED CT and ICD
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - explain how health IT systems can harm patients, for example through wrong, missing, or delayed information - report a possible clinical safety issue through the right route
You can: - describe the main parts of the health and care system and the services the organisation supports - explain why patient safety and confidentiality matter in your work
